LESSON: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY (CLASS READER)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader), part of Strand 4 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What should one look for when reading a story? 2. What qualities do you admire in people?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. with peers, read the short story and retell

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: It is developed as the learner discusses the character traits in the short story, thereby practising the skills of

effective speaking.

• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner works patiently with peers to role play different characters and discusses their

importance.

Values:
Responsibilty:It is fostered as the learner helps peers and appreciates their diversity during the group discussion.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
